svg.text: 21 x 18 fixed silhouette. AI assigns fur color roles to these regions; facial features and accessories are separate top layers.
Each colored cell is one bead/pixel region.
BG is background, OL is the fixed black outline.
LEO, LEI, LFT, LOF, LIF, LEA, FCL, FH, FCR, REA, RIF
ROF, RFT, REI, REO, MZ, NZ, CHIN
NU, CH, BU, BM, BE, BD, LSH, RSH, LFL, RFL, LFM, RFM
LUA, LLA, RUA, RLA, LUL, LLL, RUL, RLL, LP, RP
The AI does not draw the cat. It only decides which semantic color role belongs to each region. The renderer then fills this fixed grid locally.
